commit_message:
[LinalgExt] Add a  output sizes < number of batch dims check in `iree_linalg_ext.im2col` verifier (#24925)

Adds a check to ensure that the number of output sizes is greater than
or equal to the number of batch dims for the `iree_linalg_ext.im2col`
op. Without this, a batch dim index would be out of bounds when
resolving a size from the output sizes array.

`Assisted-by: Claude Code`

Signed-off-by: Ayokunle Amodu
[ayokunle321@gmail.com](mailto:ayokunle321@gmail.com)

Signed-off-by: Ayokunle Amodu <ayokunle321@gmail.com>

[LinalgExt] Add a  output sizes < number of batch dims check in `iree_linalg_ext.im2col` verifier (#24925)

Adds a check to ensure that the number of output sizes is greater than
or equal to the number of batch dims for the `iree_linalg_ext.im2col`
op. Without this, a batch dim index would be out of bounds when
resolving a size from the output sizes array.
